The client is a fast-growing financial technology company. The Founding Software Engineer will join a small engineering group to build backend services and tooling for an AI-driven software product, improve AI agent capabilities, and support shared platform infrastructure.
Management Consulting
Responsibilities
Build and extend the set of tools an AI agent can use to complete multi-step business tasks
Improve the quality, breadth and depth of the agent's capabilities so it delivers dependable end-to-end results
Combine existing tools and create new ones, such as email drafting, document completion and third-party account integrations
Contribute to the shared infrastructure that supports the company's other business lines
Own delivery from the start, ramping up quickly and working in a fast-moving, AI-assisted development workflow
Qualification
Python
Backend Development
API Development
Asynchronous Programming
Cloud Deployment
Agentic Software Development
TypeScript
High-Frequency Trading
Quantitative Engineering
Required
Between new graduate level and 5 years of engineering experience
A strong background signal, such as time at a notable startup or large technology company, or a degree from a top computer science program
Solid Python backend fundamentals, including APIs, async programming, databases and cloud deployment
Daily use of agentic coding assistants, with well-formed views on how to make agent-based systems better
A self-motivated, tech-lead-style approach: quick to ramp up, able to work with minimal guidance and comfortable with ambiguous scope
Preferred
Full-stack experience, including TypeScript on the frontend
Zero-to-one startup experience with demonstrable users
Background in high-frequency trading or quantitative engineering
Genuine interest in user experience and product, not only systems
